justification: The system must minimize false negatives because a missed malicious prompt may reach the enterprise LLM application and cause prompt injection, data leakage, or policy bypass.
Security teams need evidence showing how the model performs, including false positives, false negatives, and class-wise metrics, before trusting it as a screening layer.
measurable_indicator: Confusion matrix, classification report, precision, recall, and F1-score
